verdict.rationale: Trivy is a vulnerability/misconfiguration/secret/SBOM scanner focused on known-CVE and dependency detection; the evidence pack shows no taint-analysis or cross-file/cross-function data-flow SAST capability (e.g. no mention of source-code taint tracking like Semgrep/CodeQL). This is an applicable axis for a security scanning tool, but there is no evidence Trivy performs taint-style SAST analysis.
